text:
anya: Running the react quickstart and the page shows "Connecting..." then immediately a 403. Local env has REDWOOD_API_KEY set. App console prints 'missing token in store' and then a refresh 403. Any quick debugging tips? :thinking:

devex-bot: Created DEVEX-5204 for tracking. Please paste the minimal logs and quickstart repo link.

ravi: Which quickstart (react/vue/node)? And your REDWOOD_API_KEY - is it a personal key or workspace key?

anya: quickstart-react (github.com/redwood-inference/quickstart-react). Snippet from terminal:
```
> npm run dev
> vite v4.3.9 dev server running at:
> local: http://localhost:5173/
[2026-03-22T15:22:01Z] INFO auth: attempting cached token lookup
[2026-03-22T15:22:01Z] WARN auth: token not found in store
[2026-03-22T15:22:02Z] ERROR http: 403 Forbidden from api.redwood.ai/auth/refresh
Error: refresh failed: 403
    at Object.refresh (/app/node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/auth.js:134:21)
```

morgan: That 403 on refresh typically means the org-level refresh was blocked. If you were invited to a workspace, the org owner often needs to accept billing/terms before API refreshes succeed. Personal API keys usually bypass that gate.

ops-bot: Quick check: open https://console.redwood.ai/orgs and look for a banner about billing or trial acceptance. If present, accept/complete the step.

anya: Confirmed. There's a banner: "Enable API access for new members by accepting billing/terms". I didn't realize invite flow required that to make the first call. Is there a local dev-mode bypass?

ravi: Two options: 1) Create a personal API key (Profile -> API Keys) and set REDWOOD_API_KEY to that for local dev. 2) Use the CLI login flow: `npx @redwood/cli login` which open a browser, creates ~/.redwood/token and the SDK will pick it up. Both avoid the refresh path that trips the org gate.

morgan: Also filing a small quickstart README update to call this out explicitly. Right now the error is opaque; we should detect 403 during refresh and show a hint: "Your org may need billing/terms enabled — visit https://console.redwood.ai/orgs".

ops-bot: DEVEX-5204 updated with repro and proposed README change. Also recommended SDK improvement: return a structured error code `ERR_BILLING_GATE` when refresh returns 403 with no active token, so quickstarts can show a clearer message.

anya: FYI CLI login fixed it immediately. App now streams and hello endpoint returns 200. Will attach my repro to the ticket and happily review the README/SDK PRs. Thanks! :raised_hands:
